native_profile_model: profile-local HERMES_HOME/state.db; GatewayRunner enters _profile_runtime_scope for multiplexed inbound runs
native_event_profile_field: ABSENT in async_delegation schema/event; profile is implicit in current process scope
target_profile_auto_resolution: NO for a foreign AOTA event; target source/session resolution does not infer a parent profile from worker profile
global_gateway_cross_db_lookup: NOT_FOUND in the native completion path
api_multiplex_profile_support: YES for explicit /p/<profile>/ API routing when profile is served; gateway.wake self-post helper does not select a profile prefix
parent_db_selection: target session must be opened under the parent profile's state.db; worker profile DB is not the parent DB
parent_runtime_start_required: parent backend must be live for push wake; API server must be live for self-post
worker_can_open_parent_db: filesystem access may exist, but direct opening would bypass GatewayRunner ownership/locking/security and is not a supported delivery path
ownership_security: native path checks session existence/ended state/compression lineage, but no cross-profile AOTA principal check
cross_profile_message_injection: not supported by evidence in native async queue
native_cross_profile_delegation: not established; native queue has no explicit profile routing field
blocker: worker_profile is not parent_profile, current AOTA outbox omits parent_profile, and native delivery is scoped to the parent backend/profile
adapter_requirement: explicit parent_profile plus parent session reference, profile-aware backend routing, ownership validation, and profile-local session DB handle
